<a id="src-engine-combat-coverage-test-ts"></a>

### src/engine/combat/coverage.test.ts

Everything in combat, once each: every skill, boss move, assist, status, item, gear piece, sheet of music, enemy and boss. The mechanics tests (combat.test.ts) check *what* each rule does; this file checks that *nothing* in the tables breaks: no throw, no NaN, no runaway fight, no "undefined" in the battle log. It reads every id list, so new content is covered the moment it's added.

- Source: [src/engine/combat/coverage.test.ts](../../../src/engine/combat/coverage.test.ts)

<a id="tests-e2e-finale-spec-ts"></a>

### tests/e2e/finale.spec.ts

The whole game in a 360×740 phone: a new character through the UI, the prologue, every district's boss (dev shortcuts between districts), the second line at the club, the Tower floor by floor (the Studio Floor's rest, then up), the Conductor, the Click with Play the Blues, the ending, the credits, and New Game+ into the prologue again. Every screen is checked for overflow and, where the finale adds a screen, with axe. The console must stay clean.

- Source: [tests/e2e/finale.spec.ts](../../../tests/e2e/finale.spec.ts)
- Imports: tests: [e2e/a11y](#tests-e2e-a11y-ts), [e2e/helpers](#tests-e2e-helpers-ts)
- Packages: `@playwright/test`

### tests/integration/transcripts.test.ts

Every transcript case shows and saves what tests/fixtures/transcripts.jsonl says: v1's behavior, frozen at cutover (tests/integration/support/transcriptCases.ts). A change that's meant to alter a scene rewrites the fixture with `npm run transcripts:baseline`, and the diff is the review.

- Packages: `node:fs`, `vitest`
- Suites: “scene transcripts match the baseline”

<a id="tools-engine-properties-test-ts"></a>

### tools/engine/properties.test.ts

Properties of the engine, checked over a seeded corpus of 400 fights: - determinism: the same seed replays the same fight, with no hidden global state; - presentation: folding Heart events (hpAfter) always reproduces every actor's real Heart, so the UI can animate events without ever reading the battle's final state.
